summary.verdict: The implementation conforms to the closed contract for motor_018. It builds validation_data outputs only from registered real upstream records, preserves rights and lineage metadata, rejects synthetic or malformed inputs, emits a reconstructible manifest, and does not cross into ingestion, normalization, identity resolution, quality scoring, field evidence, claim closure or verification decisions.

findings: Functional inputs from motor_008, motor_004, motor_005, motor_006 and motor_007 are represented explicitly in the implementation interface.
Required outputs ValidationDataSet, BridgeRecord, EvidentiaryLink, BridgeManifest and EvidentiaryRecord are modeled as dataclasses and returned as a single ValidationBridgeResult.
The engine enforces registered source, validation rights, ingestion lineage, normalization trace, quality record and fixed evidence_level=validation_data before producing included bridge records.

Exclusions for unregistered source, denied rights, restriction conflict, missing ingestion lineage, missing normalization trace, missing quality record, synthetic input, quality disqualification and low-fitness exclusion are represented with explicit reason codes in BridgeManifest.
Every emitted object carries version_id, created_at, updated_at, version_hash, source_ref, produced_by_motor, produced_at and parent_id.
Content hashes are computed from canonicalized payloads and stable ids derive from those hashes, supporting deterministic rebuild and version comparison.
BridgeManifest included_record_ids are checked against ValidationDataSet bridge_record_ids, and excluded_record_refs are checked against exclusion_reasons before output is returned.
Rights, license, access and destination-policy restrictions from the source registry are propagated into dataset, bridge records, source-rights links, manifest and evidentiary record.

test_results.coverage_assessment: Focused executable smoke checks covered the documented happy path, deterministic hash repeat, unregistered source exclusion and synthetic input exclusion. The broader required behavior is specified in artifacts/tests/test_spec.md and reflected in implementation validations.
test_results.notes: The inline smoke run emitted one eligible bridge record for the valid example, reproduced the same dataset hash on repeat, excluded a missing source as SOURCE_NOT_REGISTERED, and excluded synthetic input as SYNTHETIC_INPUT_NOT_ALLOWED.
